hero.text: I design and develop for the web

about.title: About Me
about.profile_pic_alt: Mikel Aramendia, frontend developer and UX designer in Barcelona
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Mikel. My path to the web wasn't a straight line: I came from business studies, and before code there was graffiti, skateboarding, photography, electronic music, and watercolor. Each one taught me something about composition and the craft of making things.
about.paragraph2: Today I design and develop web projects focused on simplicity, usability, and a clear experience. I care about how visual design, interaction, and small details shape the way people use a product.
about.paragraph3: I also hold the Google UX Design Certificate, which reinforced my human-centered approach. This portfolio brings together personal projects, experiments, and continuous learning.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: These are some of the web projects I've built for fun, learning, or just to see if I could. Each one taught me something new and gave me a chance to experiment with different ideas and technologies.

socratika.title: Socratika: Chat With History's Greatest Minds
socratika.paragraph1: A full-stack digital Agora that brings history's greatest minds to life through AI conversation. Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Google Genkit.
socratika.paragraph2: Features multilingual support, user accounts, Stripe subscriptions, real-time streaming chat via Firebase, automated minipaper generation, and a comprehensive admin dashboard with usage analytics.

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin History
bitcoin.paragraph1: An interactive D3.js visualization chronicling Bitcoin's price history with key events. Features logarithmic/linear scaling, zoom, event markers, and light/dark themes.
bitcoin.paragraph2: Built with Vite and D3.js v7. Features a narrative-driven timeline with 30+ curated events, a linked context brush for zooming, an educational halving explainer, and full bilingual EN/ES support.

when_lambo.title: When Lambo
when_lambo.paragraph1: A humorous Bitcoin-to-Lamborghini calculator that tells you how close you are to owning a supercar based on your crypto holdings.
when_lambo.paragraph2: Features multi-source Bitcoin price API with automatic failover, live fiat exchange rates, Canvas-generated share images per car model, shareable URL presets, and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index.

pulse_roots.title: PulseRoots: Interactive Electronic Music Genre Explorer
pulse_roots.paragraph1: An interactive visualization of electronic music's evolution. Built with Astro and D3.js v6, it maps the complex web of genres and subgenres into an explorable hierarchical tree.
pulse_roots.paragraph2: Features three visualization modes (tree, radial, and history timeline), embedded Spotify track previews, 107 curated music history milestones from 1897 to 2024, and bilingual EN/ES support.

new_contemporary_photography.title: New Contemporary Photography
new_contemporary_photography.paragraph1: A single-page application that fetches random photographs from a Flickr photography group via a two-step API pipeline with intelligent image prefetching.
new_contemporary_photography.paragraph2: Features progressive image preloading, auto-play slideshow mode, photo download and clipboard sharing, and a high-contrast brutalist aesthetic.

drake.title: Drake Equation Visualizer
drake.paragraph1: An interactive 3D visualization of the Drake Equation that estimates the number of extraterrestrial civilizations in the Milky Way. Built with Three.js, Chart.js, and vanilla JavaScript.
drake.paragraph2: Adjust each parameter with real-time sliders and watch how it influences the final estimate. Features a procedural 3D Milky Way with 15K–50K stars, sensitivity analysis charts, live NASA exoplanet data, and shareable preset URLs.

plaintext.title: Plaintext: Typography-Driven Wallpaper Generator
plaintext.paragraph1: A vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas wallpaper generator that transforms curated quotes into high-resolution typographic posters with Swiss design-inspired layouts.
plaintext.paragraph2: Features three Swiss-inspired layout algorithms (Editorial, Ruled, Offset), a vibe-based color system, custom typeface selection, multi-resolution export up to 4K, and a bilingual EN/ES interface.

only3left.title: Only 3 Left: Deceptive UX Patterns
only3left.paragraph1: An interactive catalogue of deceptive UX patterns: dark patterns, manipulative interfaces, and persuasive mechanisms used to influence decisions online. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
only3left.paragraph2: Features 42 documented patterns across 10 categories with interactive live specimens and a TrapRevealer overlay, toxicity ratings, psychological breakdowns, ethical alternatives per pattern, search and category filtering, and a MetaToast educational overlay. Fully bilingual (EN/ES).

less_is_more.title: Less Is More UI (AI Agent Skill)
less_is_more.description: An extensible CSS design system and AI agent skill that enforces modernist design constraints during frontend generation. Integrates a semantic CSS token system, architectural principles, and minimalist anti-patterns to ensure AI-generated interfaces remain timeless and human-centered.

marsconnect.title: UX Case Study: MarsConnect
marsconnect.description: This project focuses on designing an onboarding app for future Mars colonists, aiming to guide users through essential procedures to adapt to their new life on the planet. The app also offers personalized recommendations and events to foster integration into the first Martian colony.

design_forward_summit.title: UX Case Study: Design Forward Summit
design_forward_summit.description: This project involves designing a web platform to facilitate the nomination process for a design conference, making it more intuitive and accessible. The goal was to simplify navigation, improve submission confirmations, and ensure a smooth user experience.

guardians_polecat.title: UX Case Study: Guardians of the Polecat
guardians_polecat.description: The 'Guardians of the Polecat' project is an interactive platform designed to raise awareness about the conservation of the European polecat. Through a mobile app and a responsive website, it allows users to report sightings, participate in volunteer events, and symbolically adopt this endangered species.
